messages:
sarah: Quick check — we need 4x A100s in us-west2 for a short inference smoke tomorrow 09:00 PT. Low preempt risk required, ~3h window. Anyone have capacity available or a vendor fallback?

nick: Do you need dedicated reserved capacity or is a spot blend okay? spots could be cheaper but higher evict risk.

sarah: Prefer reserved/standby since this test is latency-sensitive. Budget approved for short reserved borrow.

robin: FYI finance already greenlit INF-2346 for temporary reserved hours. If vendor can commit, we can spin up.

vendor-ops-bot: Vendor A report: 2x A100 available immediately in us-west2, 2x availability pending (expected +2 within 2–3 hours). SLA for reserved borrow requires PR/approval. Link: https://vendor-portal.example.com/alloc/REQ-789

taylor: Copying in vendor contact: @nick can you nudge vendor on ETA SLA? If they can push the remaining 2 into a hot-standby we can start tests at 09:00.

nick: Pinged vendor via DM — they said they can prioritize but need a terraform tag to claim the slots. Suggest we create a short PR that tags the pool: `terraform apply -target=module.demo_pool` and include tenant tag `team=inference-smoke`.

sarah: I'll open the PR now and add the timebox. PR: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2450 (also will add a comment linking this thread).

sarah: PR snippet:
```
resource "redwood_gpu_alloc" "temp_borrow" {
  region = "us-west2"
  sku = "a100-40gb"
  count = 4
  tags = { team = "inference-smoke", window = "2026-03-22T09:00Z/2026-03-22T12:00Z" }
}
```

taylor: Looks good, please assign to @robin for quick LGTM. Also add `cap_priority = "reserved-borrow"` if vendor needs it to fast-track.

robin: I'll review PR in 10m. If vendor confirms the remaining 2, we can merge and vendor claims slots. If vendor only has 2, plan B: 2 reserved + 2 spot fallback and adjust test parallelism.

sarah: Sounds good. One more ask — can we get a temporary quota bump if vendor alloc needs the project quota? Who handles quota requests? @nick?

nick: Yep I can file a quick quota request with cloud. I'll include vendor allocation ID and PR link. Expect response within 30–60m during business hours.

sarah: Awesome. Will update INF-2450 with vendor confirmation. Thanks all :thumbsup:

vendor-ops-bot: Vendor update: Alloc REQ-789 status -> PARTIAL_CONFIRMED (2 immediate, 2 pending). ETA for remaining: ~01:50 PT. Will post when confirmed.
